text: A woman alone, a door she couldn't open. Let's see who else was in that hallway.
I kept watch every night. It only moves when the lights go out. Pick a square before it stops.
Hmph. I'll watch her pulse. Ghosts don't have one, people do.
Marina said she lives alone.
The scope needs a face to find a heartbeat. Let it work.
Click a card. I will show you that moment of the tape, and the crew will argue about it.
I will write down what the scope sees. Nothing else.
Spirit of this room… is someone here with us?
The glass went to YES, and stopped. Stay very still…
A held breath right at the 3-second line is noticed only some of the time. Below it, never. I would rather miss a gasp than invent one.
Wait… before you go. Will you come back?
EVERYBODY OUT! Out, out, out!
Shhh… I'm Luna. I open the board, and I believe in everything. Almost.
Dr. Bigotes. I believe in data. Show me a pulse and I'll show you a person.
I'm Xochi. I keep watch all night and write down only what the scope saw.
Marina, alive the whole time. This is the line every other card is compared to.
Here. The SDK counted two faces, and Marina was the only one breathing.
Right behind her. A face, and no pulse at all. A mask does that. So does a ghost, says Luna.
No face in that spot at all. A coat, a shadow.
Too dark to read. I will not call it a ghost.
She stopped at the door and held her breath. Listening to something.
Her pulse climbs. The lamp flickered a moment before. A startle, most likely.
It says it stood behind her. Presage counted a second face from second 8, and she never turned around.
Two faces in the frame is what the SDK reported. It does not say whose. A reflection counts too.
No. That face gave 0 beats while the scope watched it. Nothing alive holds that still.
A face with no pulse is a photo, a mask or a screen. Ordinary. I just cannot tell you who put it there.
She held her breath at second 21. She felt it, she never saw it. It was telling her: don't go.
Her pulse rose 9 bpm in a few seconds. A startle does that. So does a flickering lamp. A bad feeling is not a ghost.
The second face left the frame at second 38. The glass says it did not leave the house.
The SDK stopped counting a second face at second 38. People walk out of frame. That is all I can sign.
It said goodbye.
Session closed.
It never left. It is still in the hallway, right where she cannot see it.
Okay. I have no explanation for that. Yet.
One living face from start to end, with a pulse around 83 bpm.
At second 8 something else had a face in that hallway, for 30 seconds.
She stopped at the door and held her breath for 3.9 seconds.
Then her pulse rose 9.3 bpm. A startle, most likely.
Here is what I think it meant. It stood behind her and she stayed home. It was not hunting her. It was keeping her in.
Or a dark hallway and a bad feeling. I measured a face with no pulse. I did not measure a ghost.
Just Marina, coming home. One face, one pulse.
She was out. The hallway stayed dark.
Her sister visited. Two faces, two pulses.
Halloween. Three trick-or-treaters at the door, all alive.
The night she did not go out. Two faces. One heartbeat. Who else was there?
Case 02. It is outside her bedroom.
Not sent yet.
Wait. Presage just reported two faces in the frame. At 0:08.
These numbers are samples. The spirit is fiction. Marina stayed home, and that is the part that matters.
The measurements are real. The spirit is fiction. Marina stayed home, and that is the part that matters.
These numbers are samples. The spirit is fiction. What you felt is yours.
The measurements are real. The spirit is fiction. What you felt is yours.
Every face in this video has a heartbeat.
Except one.

It was the night of November 2nd. Bag ready, keys in my hand, coat on. Everything was fine. Then I got to the door and this feeling hit me, so strong I couldn't breathe. Stay home. I took my coat off and I stayed. I live alone, and I saw nothing. But the hallway camera was on. Can you look?
Do you dare?
